findings.text: precision() duplicates the paired precision-budget comparison that scripts/prototypes/bank_solve_cycle/report.py:18 already owns - the same four keys, unit denominators, first-lane oracle-boundary construction and limits (1e-8, 5e-4, 1e-4) - copied into a new file rather than imported or extended in the owner, so the two implementations will drift the next time a budget changes.

the provenance header runs `python -c` with cwd at the worktree, so '' at sys.path[0] shadows PYTHONPATH; with PYTHONPATH=/tmp/nonexistent-arm the same command still printed the worktree's nova, and every cpu-*.log header therefore names the worktree rather than the arm it measured - the arms themselves are established by the in-process PROVENANCE lines and by the base arm failing where head passes.
